negative_reviews.author: Blyiena ash
negative_reviews.text: I had a disappointing experience at Maki Ramen because of my interaction with the manager, Imi. During my visit, I felt unwelcome due to his tone and attitude. His comments came across as sarcastic, and his laughter felt dismissive rather than friendly. The way he spoke to customers made me feel like he didn't want us there and that we should leave the restaurant. Customer service is an important part of the dining experience, and unfortunately, this interaction left a negative impression on me. I visited last week and I will not  be returning. I would not recommend this restaurant to others.

negative_reviews.author: Colleen Mei
negative_reviews.text:
Maki&Ramenは他の都市の店舗でも何回か訪れたことがあります。料理(特にラーメン)はJapanese "inspired" ramenという感じで、美味しい食事に辿り着くことに困らないロンドンに出店したことに驚きでした。とてもチャレンジャーですね。
イギリスらしく決して安い価格帯ではないので、きちんとした日本食を食べたい方は他のお店をおすすめします。ビーガンラーメンを探してる方にはいいかもしれません。

(Translated by Google)
I've visited Maki&Ramen several times at their other locations in different cities. Their food (especially the ramen) is a kind of "Japanese-inspired" ramen, and I was surprised they opened a branch in London, a city where finding delicious food is already a challenge. They're quite the risk-taker.

As is typical in the UK, the prices aren't cheap, so if you're looking for authentic Japanese food, I'd recommend other restaurants. It might be a good option for those looking for vegan ramen.
